title: fix(metadata-protocol): deleting an own-package object extension fills the stored computed fields it hands back
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_
Part of #32958
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the published skills teach neither the delete door's answer keys nor the stored-expression fill any metadata door runs; an optional key on the delete answer changes nothing an author writes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:删除自有包的 `object_extension`(它曾重定义一个存储型计算字段的表达式)时,删除入口现在会像保存、回滚、撤销入口一样,把对象已有记录按恢复后的表达式重算回填,并在返回里用新的可选 `advisories` 逐字段说明。
- **为什么改**:删除扩展后对象已改用原表达式计算,但老记录仍是被删表达式算出的值,报表、筛选、汇总读到的都是旧数,且没有任何提示。
- **风险与回滚**:回填只在删除确实让某个存储计算字段改变时才跑,复用保存入口同一条回填路径;回填失败不会让删除失败,只在 `advisories` 里报未完成。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`(注册表 heal 前后的 capture/fill 两处)、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`(`DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema.advisories`)、`packages/objectql/src/stored-expression-backfill.test.ts`(两种保存顺序的钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/stored-expression-backfill.test.ts -t 32958`,预期 4 个用例全绿(本修复之前前两个是红的:行值停在 `[8, 16, 24]`)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`deleteMetaItem` (`DELETE /api/v1/meta/:type/:name`) removed the row and healed the registry, so the object served the definition beneath the removed one, but it ran no stored-expression fill. Deleting an own-package `object_extension` that re-declared a stored computed field therefore left every existing row on the value the removed expression computed.

- `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`: on the repository path's row-deleted branch, an active-state delete captures the object's stored computed fields (`captureStoredExpressionChange`) before `restoreArtifactRegistryView`, and runs `fillStoredExpressionChange` after the audit row, projector and mutation event, before the answer: the save door's order. The notices ride a new omitted-when-empty `advisories` on the answer. A draft discard captures nothing. No storage sync is added, matching the revert door's removal limb from #32921.
- `protocol.ts`: the two delete signatures and the public docblock declare `advisories`.
- `protocol-stored-expression-fill.ts`: the module docblock lists the delete door among the doors that fill.
- `packages/spec`: `DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema` gains optional `advisories: RuntimeAuthoringIssue[]`; its docblock no longer says the key is deliberately undeclared. Regenerated: `authorable-surface/api.json` (one key), `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch (the same grading as #32921).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/stored-expression-backfill.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('[#32958] …')` in the existing door harness (real protocol, real engine):
  1. object saved, then the extension: delete ⇒ registry serves the owner's expression, rows `[1, 2, 3]`, 3 row writes, one `stored-expression-filled` notice, and the answer parses through `DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema` unstripped. CONTROL before the delete: the extension's expression served and rows `[8, 16, 24]`.
  2. extension saved, then the object: same assertions, same CONTROL.
  3. an extension that changed no stored computed field: no row write, no `advisories` key.
  4. a draft discard: no row write, no `advisories` key.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the pin that said the delete answer declares neither `version` nor `advisories` is split: `version` stays undeclared; `advisories` is declared, carried, and absent on a clean answer.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's second item is NOT in this PR**, hence `Part of #32958`: the `object-storage-sync-refused` text (`objectStorageSyncRefusedNotice`) still speaks of "this save" and "publish the object again" on rollback and revert answers. That function lives in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, a file held by in-flight E1 work for this pilot, so it was not edited. The delete door added here runs no storage sync and never emits that notice.
- The no-row branch of the delete door (no stored row, a stale registry shadow healed) captures and fills nothing; it is unchanged.
- The legacy raw-engine delete path serves only code-only types (`job`, `agent`) and defines no object; unchanged.
- A removed extension that changed a stored field's TYPE (not only its expression) gets the fill but no storage sync, as the revert door's removal limb does today.
- Overlapping open PR checked: #33193 edits `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` in other schemas (history/rollback request), not `DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Premise on origin/main (e540baf8), both orders: red</summary>

```
× object saved first, then the extension: the delete rewrites every row the removed expression computed
× extension saved first, then the object: the delete rewrites every row the removed expression computed
AssertionError: expected [ 8, 16, 24 ] to deeply equal [ 1, 2, 3 ]   (both, at the rows assertion; the registry assertion before it passed)
Tests  2 failed | 2 passed | 60 skipped (64)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the omitted-when-empty answer (one mutation, both negative pins)</summary>

Mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the spread of `advisories` replaced by an unconditional `advisories` key; `ablation-dist-preflight` proved the marker in `metadata-protocol/dist` (2 files). Result: tests 3 and 4 red (`Tests 2 failed | 2 passed`). Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD`, blob hash equal to HEAD's, rebuild, `--absent` preflight clean, whole tree clean; all 4 green again.
</details>
